{"subject":"Recap: assay results pipeline and hosting options","body":"Hi Ingrid, Victor and Camila,

Thanks for your time today. In the sandbox, plate reader files were parsed and joined with your LIMS metadata, with results in the table about two minutes after a file landed. A replay of a week of your files ran in under an hour, against your busy day of about 300 plates. The curve-fit flag and the audit trail matched what you described.

Open on our side:
- Marcus will add the plate ID to the poor-fit flag.
- Marcus will confirm the exact wording on EU-only support access with our compliance team before you rely on it.
- I have attached our standard DPA so your legal team can start in parallel.

Hosting is still open. Frankfurt is available, with backups and audit logs in the tenant's region, and either option works for us. Camila is finding the memo for Victor to review.

Is there a date that works for a hosting follow-up once you have aligned?

Sam","customer_value_line":"Results landing about two minutes after a plate file supports your goal of deciding the next run the same afternoon and taking a week or more out of each screening campaign.","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U006","excerpt":"the results show up in this table within about two minutes of the file landing."},{"utterance_id":"U004","excerpt":"If they could decide the same afternoon, we think we could take a week or more out of each screening campaign."},{"utterance_id":"U044","excerpt":"The sandbox handled a replay of a week of your files in under an hour."},{"utterance_id":"U010","excerpt":"We can add the plate ID to the flag so they can see if it's always the same plate."},{"utterance_id":"U021","excerpt":"I'd want to confirm the exact wording with our compliance team before you rely on it."},{"utterance_id":"U041","excerpt":"We have a standard DPA, I can send it with the recap so your legal team can start on it in parallel."},{"utterance_id":"U027","excerpt":"I can find the memo."}]}
